content: खर्वटः, -टम् [खर्व्-अटन्] .²1 A market-town. .²2 A village at the foot of a mountain; this word generally occurs joined with खेट; <ls>Bhāg. 1. 6. 11</ls>, <ls n="Bhāg.">4. 18. 31</ls>, <ls n="Bhāg.">7. 2. 14</ls>; धनुःशतं परीणाहो ग्रामे क्षेत्रान्तरं भवेत् . द्वे शते खर्वटस्य स्यान्नगरस्य चतुःशतम् .. <ls>Y. 2. 167</ls>. Mitākṣarā says खर्वटस्य प्रचुरकण्टकसन्तानस्य ग्रामस्य खर्वटानि कुनगराणि . (प्रश्नव्याकरणसूत्रव्याख्याने). .²3 A mixed locality on the bank of a river, partly a village and partly a town (according to the text of Bhṛgu, quoted in Shrīdharasvāminʼs commentary on the <ls>Bhāg.</ls>); <ab>cf.</ab> Rājadharmakaustubha, <ls>G. O. S. 72, p. 103</ls>. .²4 A principal village among two hundred ones (<ls>Dānasāgara, Bibliotheca Indica 274, Fasc. I, p. 145</ls>); <ab>cf.</ab> also <ls>Daṇḍaviveka, G. O. S. 52, p. 277</ls>.
